properties.title: SQS Empty Receives vs Messages Received

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/story-generation-worker' | fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /story_id/
| stats count() by bin(5m)
properties.title: Story Processing Activity (Count by 5min)

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/story-generation-worker'
| fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /❌/ or @message like /error/i or @message like /Error/ or @message like /ERROR/ or @message like /failed/i or @message like /Failed/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 50
properties.title: Recent Errors & Failures

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/story-generation-worker'
| fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /error/i or @message like /Error/ or @message like /ERROR/ or @message like /failed/i or @message like /Failed/
| stats count() as error_count by bin(5m)
| sort @timestamp desc
properties.title: Error Rate Over Time

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/story-generation-worker'
| fields @timestamp, @message, @requestId
| filter @message like /Processing job/ or @message like /📝 Processing job/
| parse @message /job (?<job_id>[a-zA-Z0-9-]+) for story (?<story_id>[a-zA-Z0-9_]+)/
| stats count() as jobs_started by bin(5m)
| sort @timestamp desc
properties.title: Jobs Started Over Time

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/story-generation-worker'
| fields @timestamp, @message, @requestId
| filter @message like /✅ Completed job/ or @message like /✅ Story generation completed/
| parse @message /job (?<job_id>[a-zA-Z0-9-]+)/
| stats count() as jobs_completed by bin(5m)
| sort @timestamp desc
properties.title: Jobs Completed Over Time

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/story-generation-worker'
| fields @timestamp, @message, @duration, @billedDuration, @memorySize, @maxMemoryUsed
| filter ispresent(@duration)
| stats avg(@duration) as avg_duration, max(@duration) as max_duration, min(@duration) as min_duration, pct(@duration, 99) as p99_duration by bin(5m)
| sort @timestamp desc
properties.title: Lambda Execution Duration from Logs (ms)

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/story-generation-worker'
| fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /🚀 Lambda invoked/ or @message like /Lambda invoked/
| stats count() as invocations by bin(5m)
| sort @timestamp desc
properties.title: Lambda Invocations from Logs

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/story-generation-worker'
| fields @timestamp, @message, @requestId
| filter @message like /story_id/ or @message like /job_id/
| parse @message /story (?<story_id>[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/
| parse @message /job (?<job_id>[a-zA-Z0-9-]+)/
| stats count() as unique_stories by story_id
| sort count desc
| limit 10
properties.title: Top Stories by Processing Count

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/story-generation-worker'
| fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /🎬 Starting story generation/ or @message like /Starting story generation/
| parse @message /Starting story generation for (?<story_id>[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/
| stats count() as stories_started, earliest(@timestamp) as first_seen, latest(@timestamp) as last_seen by story_id
| sort count desc
| limit 20
properties.title: Recent Story Processing Activity

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/story-generation-worker'
| fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /📦 Received/ or @message like /Received/
| parse @message /Received (?<message_count>[0-9]+) message\(s\)/
| stats sum(message_count) as total_messages_received by bin(5m)
| sort @timestamp desc
properties.title: SQS Messages Received (from Logs)

properties.query:
SOURCE '/aws/lambda/story-generation-worker'
| fields @timestamp, @message, @requestId
| filter @message like /error/ or @message like /Error/ or @message like /ERROR/ or @message like /failed/ or @message like /Failed/
| parse @message /(?<error_type>[^:]+): (?<error_message>.*)/
| stats count() as error_count by error_type
| sort count desc
| limit 10
properties.title: Error Types Summary
